content.comment_body: Thank you! Is it possible to save the file as XLSX or even XLS format? Best regards, [user_name]
Simply rename the generated file, and it will have the XLSX extension!

analysis.insight_summary: Users value the CSV to Excel file conversion feature, but there is interest in being able to save files directly in Excel formats like XLS and XLSX. Minimal instructions were provided, resulting in some ambiguity about the direct support for native Excel exports and overall usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the tool to allow for direct saving in native Excel formats (XLS, XLSX) to improve usability and compatibility.
